kashika: घोरित्येव। कर्मण्युपपदे घुसंज्ञकेभ्यो धातुभ्यः किः प्रत्ययो भवत्यधिकरणे कारके। जलं धीयतेऽस्मिन्निति जलधिः। शरधिः। अधिकरणग्रहणमर्थान्तरनिरासार्थम्। चकारः प्रत्ययानुकर्षणार्थः॥
kashikaEnglish: कि after घु verbs with accusative upapada for location: जलधिः 'ocean' (water-holder), शरधिः 'quiver' (arrow-holder).
englishFull:
आधारेऽर्द्वितीयायाश्च — The affix कि applies after a घु verb when a word in the accusative case is in composition and the word denotes "location" (आधार).

| Formation | Meaning |
|-----------|---------|
| जलधिः | ocean ("in which water is held") |
| शरधिः | quiver ("in which arrows are placed") |

The word "location" indicates the words should have no other significance. The च draws कि from the previous sūtra.
